name: Odonata
effect: The first Archwing — balanced all-rounder. Energy Shell blocks frontal damage, Seeking Fire homes in on enemies.
effects: 1 — Energy Shell: frontal energy shield that absorbs damage
2 — Seeking Fire: homing missile barrage
3 — Disarray: confuses enemies in range
4 — Repel: radial blast that knocks back everything
farm: Archwing quest reward — everyone gets this first.
tips: Great starter, but outclassed by Amesha for defense and Itzal for speed.

name: Odonata Prime
effect: Primed Odonata — better stats across the board. Same abilities, tankier and faster.
effects: Same 4 abilities as Odonata
Higher shields, health, and speed
farm: Vaulted Prime — relic farm or Prime Resurgence when available.
tips: Worth it if you love Odonata's kit but want more survivability.

name: Elytron
effect: The bomber Archwing — built for AoE destruction. Thumper drops mines, Warhead fires a massive nuke.
effects: 1 — Thumper: drops proximity mines
2 — Core Vent: radial heat burst around you
3 — Warhead: fires a huge homing nuke
4 — Bloomer: chaff that redirects enemy fire
tips: Best Archwing for clearing Archwing defense/mobile defense missions fast.

name: Amesha
effect: The support/tank Archwing — the best defensive option. Warding Grace slows all nearby enemies by 75%.
effects: 1 — Warding Grace: slows ALL nearby enemies, massive team survivability
2 — Benevolent Decoy: draws enemy fire
3 — Vengeful Rush: speed boost that converts damage taken into energy
4 — Surge Protocol: team buff
tips: THE pick for hard Archwing content (Jordas Golem, Razorback). Warding Grace trivializes defense objectives.
Also great for Archwing rush missions — pop Vengeful Rush and fly.
tags: archwing amesha support tank defense space

name: Itzal
effect: The speed Archwing — fastest in the game. Blink teleports you forward, Penumbra turns you invisible.
effects: 1 — Blink: instant teleport dash (the fastest movement in Archwing)
2 — Penumbra: invisibility
3 — Cosmic Crush: pulls enemies in and crushes them
4 — Suppression: disables enemy abilities
tips: Fastest way to clear Archwing capture/sabotage/exterminate — Blink past everything.
Penumbra + Cosmic Crush is a great combo for defense.

name: Archgun Deployer
effect: Lets you call down your Archgun as a heavy weapon in normal ground missions. A game-changer for open worlds and Steel Path.
effects: HOW TO UNLOCK: Complete the Profit-Taker Orb heist (Fortuna). The Archgun Deployer is the rank 5 Solaris United reward — buy it from Little Duck for 120,000 standing.
HOW IT WORKS: Equip it in your Gear wheel. Deploying calls your Archgun down in a pod. 10-minute cooldown between uses (starts when you pick it up).
GRAVIMAG: Each Archgun needs a Gravimag installed (1 per gun) to be deployable on the ground. Gravimags come from the Profit-Taker Orb fight (Phase 2+ drops).
AMMO: Deployed archguns use Archgun ammo pickups (dropped by enemies) — NOT your normal ammo. Bring Ammo Case or a sentinel with Ammo Drum if running long missions.
BEST PICK: Mausolon is the meta — charge shot AoE melts everything. Larkspur and Fluctus are strong backups.
farm: Profit-Taker Orb (Fortuna) — rank 5 Solaris United, buy from Little Duck.
tips: Install a Gravimag on your Mausolon FIRST — it's the one you'll use 90% of the time.
The deployer trivializes open-world bounties and Eidolon-adjacent content.
tags: archgun deployer profit-taker gravimag ground heavy weapon guide

name: Mausolon (Deployer)
effect: THE meta Archgun Deployer pick. Charge shot fires a massive AoE blast. Melts Steel Path crowds.
effects: Mods: Rubedo-Lined Barrel, Sabot Rounds, Parallax Scope, Critical Focus, Hollowed Bullets, Combustion Rounds, Venomous Clip, Magma Chamber
Alternate: swap Combustion Rounds for radiation/viral depending on faction
Comes free with the Voidrig Necramech
farm: Necraloid (Father) — Isolation Vault bounties. Or free with Voidrig.
tips: Charge shots are the main damage — tap-fire for crowds, charge for heavies.
Needs a Gravimag to deploy on ground.
tags: archgun mausolon deployer best meta build

name: Larkspur (Deployer)
effect: Chargeable AoE archgun — great Deployer backup if you don't have Mausolon yet.
effects: Mods: Rubedo-Lined Barrel, Sabot Rounds, Parallax Scope, Critical Focus, Hollowed Bullets, Venomous Clip, Magma Chamber, Polar Magazine
Tap-fire for rapid shots, full charge for the big blast
tips: Solid all-rounder. Easier to get than Mausolon if you haven't done Deimos yet.

name: Fluctus (Deployer)
effect: Infinite punch-through waves — hits everything in a line. Great for corridors and defense.
effects: Mods: Rubedo-Lined Barrel, Sabot Rounds, Parallax Scope, Automatic Trigger, Hollowed Bullets, Venomous Clip, Magma Chamber, Zodiac Shred
tips: The waves go through walls — amazing for Mobile Defense and Excavation.

name: Archwing Missions Guide
effect: Where to play Archwing and what each mission type is for.
effects: UNLOCK: Complete 'The Archwing' quest (Junction: Mars → Phobos).
BEST NODES: Kepler (Phobos) — Rush, great for leveling. Erpo (Earth) — Mobile Defense. Salacia (Neptune) — Mobile Defense, popular farm.
FARMING: Archwing mods drop from all Archwing enemies. Salacia (Neptune) MD is the go-to farm.
JORDAS GOLEM: Archwing boss on Eris — drops Atlas parts. Bring Amesha (defense) or Elytron (damage).
RAZORBACK: Archwing boss event — drops Gorgon Wraith parts. Comes around periodically.
TIP: You barely need Archwing after the star chart — but you NEED it leveled for Jordas and Razorback.
tips: Level on Kepler (Phobos) Rush — fastest Archwing XP.
Amesha makes every Archwing mission trivial with Warding Grace.
